text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
The me of another world witnessed many 
races that would later be hailed as 
"legendary duels", but—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
...Perhaps regarding that 'Takarazuka 
Kinen,' the circumstances were a little 
different.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"...In that other world, in the Takarazuka 
Kinen hyped up as Spe and Grass's first 
showdown, I finished 3rd right behind 
them... but—"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
About 10 horse-lengths behind Grass in 
1st. And 7 horse-lengths behind Spe in 
2ndâ

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
The other me could only watch from behind 
during their "legendary showdowns."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
As those two brilliant lights clashed, I 
wonder what was going through the mind of 
the one watching from the closest vantage 
point...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
—...That being said, none of that matters 
right now.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
...This is my journey. This is our 
Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"No matter how strong Spe and the others 
are... We can't let it just end as a 
'legendary showdown' between the two of 
them, right?"

text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! Both Special Week and Grass 
Wonder are in peak condition! Their spirit 
is off the charts...!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I wonder who will win...!? Oh man, I can't 
wait...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Spe-chan.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I have been looking forward to this. To 
competing with you for supremacy like 
this.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I have too...! I've tuned myself up to 
absolute perfection for today...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna hit you with everything! 
Grass-chan, with all my might!!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ――Just as I declared, I'll be joining in.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...How sharp.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Make sure you guys have fun too.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
After all, today... is our "Takarazuka 
Kinen."
